qsm-models doctor.description: Report that the binary needs no program on PATH: every library it runs is compiled into it

qsm-models lint.description: Lint the BPMN and C4 graphs: the standard tools' checks, then this plugin's rules

args.name: path
args.description: a .bpmn or .c4 file, or the directory that holds them (default models)

qsm-models layout.description: Write the diagram geometry of each BPMN process that has none; refuse a file that has a layout

args.name: file
args.description: the .bpmn file to lay out in place

qsm-models render.description: Write one SVG per BPMN process and one .drawio.svg per generated C4 view beside the graph

args.name: path
args.description: a .bpmn or .c4 file, or the directory that holds them (default models)

args.name: check
args.description: write nothing; name each picture that differs from what render would write

qsm-models paths.description: Print the cover of each process: start-to-end paths with stable ids

args.name: file
args.description: the .bpmn graph (default the one under models)

args.name: process
args.description: only this process, by id, with or without its _process suffix

args.name: all
args.description: every path, not only the cover

args.name: specs
args.description: a directory of specs: name each cover path no scenario cites and each cited id that does not exist

qsm-models check.description: Find model files outside models/ and every link of the graphs that does not resolve

qsm-models pages.description: Lint the graphs and write bpmn.html and c4.html, each one self-contained file

args.name: out
args.description: the directory to write into (default .qsm/models at the repository root)
